notion.guide.step1.title: Create an integration
notion.guide.step1.body: In Notion, under notion.so/profile/integrations, create an internal integration with Read, Update and Insert Content.
notion.guide.step2.title: Save the API key
notion.guide.step2.body: Paste the token into the API key field. The browser never receives saved keys back.
notion.guide.step3.title: Share the page
notion.guide.step3.body: Create a Notion page for StudyRunner data and invite the integration with full access.
notion.guide.step4.title: Set the study target
notion.guide.step4.body: Enter the parent page ID or an existing database ID in the active study target card.

stimulus.editorNote: Warm-up only shows the instruction view. Study signals, TouchDesigner routing, Mini-radar recording, camera snapshots, media triggers, and custom JS start when the active timer begins. BrainBit data LSL runs globally and continuously when enabled in hardware settings. HTML and JS trigger types stay blocked unless the server explicitly enables STUDY_RUNNER_ALLOW_UNSAFE_STIMULUS_CODE=1.

nextcloud.title: Nextcloud Settings
nextcloud.subtitle: After a study, the result folder is copied to a shared Nextcloud folder. You only need a share link that allows uploading.
nextcloud.step1.title: Share a folder in Nextcloud
nextcloud.step1.body: Create a folder for study data, share it as a link, and allow uploading (permission "Allow upload and editing").
nextcloud.step2.title: Paste the share link
nextcloud.step2.body: Copy the link from Nextcloud into the field below. It looks like https://cloud.example.com/s/AbCdEf123.
nextcloud.step3.title: Add the password if the link has one
nextcloud.step3.body: Only needed if you protected the share with a password. It stays on this computer and is never sent back to the browser.
nextcloud.step4.title: Test and switch on
nextcloud.step4.body: Press "Test connection", then switch on the upload for this study and save.
nextcloud.activeStudyHint: The share link is saved with the study.
nextcloud.shareLinkHint: Paste the link exactly as Nextcloud shows it.
nextcloud.onHint: Completed sessions of this study are copied to Nextcloud.
nextcloud.offHint: This study does not upload anything to Nextcloud.
nextcloud.linkMissingHint: Without a share link nothing can be uploaded.

nextcloud.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.subtitle: The tablet needs this certificate once so its camera may be used. Scan the code below on the tablet, then follow the steps.
certificate.step1.title: Scan the code on the tablet
certificate.step1.body: Open the camera app on the tablet and scan the code in the "Tablet setup" card. The download starts by itself.
certificate.step2.title: Install the downloaded profile
certificate.step2.body: On the iPad: Settings, then "Profile downloaded" at the top, then Install. The iPad asks for its passcode.
certificate.step3.title: Switch on full trust
certificate.step3.body: Settings, General, About, Certificate Trust Settings: switch on "Study Runner Local Root CA". Apple requires this last step to be done by hand.
certificate.step4.title: Open the study page
certificate.step4.body: Use the participant link from the hub. The page should open without a warning and may use the camera.
certificate.fingerprintHint: Use this to check on the tablet that you installed the right certificate.
certificate.downloadHint: The tablet must be on the same network as this computer.
certificate.moveBody: Save the certificate here and load it on the other computer. Tablets that already trust this certificate then need no new setup.
certificate.moveWarning: Keep this file private: whoever has it can pretend to be any website towards your tablets.
certificate.loadFailed: Could not load the certificate status
certificate.validUntilHint: Tablets keep trusting it until this date.
certificate.noLocalCertificate: No local certificate on this computer.
certificate.addressesHint: The certificate is valid for these addresses of this computer.
certificate.httpsOffHint: Without a secure connection the tablet camera cannot be used.

certificate.httpsConfiguredHint: A certificate provided by you is in use, so no tablet setup is needed here.
certificate.httpsLocalCaHint: Tablets need this certificate once, then the camera works.
certificate.qrFailed: The code could not be drawn. Type the address on the tablet instead.
certificate.downloadFailedHint: The download helper could not start. The study itself is unaffected.
certificate.downloadDisabledHint: No download is needed: this computer does not use its own certificate.
certificate.downloadUnknownHint: Start Study Runner with a secure connection to enable the download.
certificate.importUnchanged: This certificate was already in use
certificate.importUnchangedBody: The file contains the certificate this computer already uses. Nothing changed.
certificate.importedBody: Restart Study Runner so the new certificate is used. Tablets that already trust it need no new setup.
